papers.area: pre-registered discovery tournament, wave 3 close, Binance USDT-M perpetuals, 4h-24h horizons

assignments.output: wave-plan record with per-candidate referee verdicts and the survive-all-attacks-and-the-one-look statement
second wave-3 record per the same protocol

papers.claim: Zero of the two referee-stage candidates survive all attacks and the one look. r301 (cross-sectional 7d momentum, k=5, 24h hold) is NOT CONFIRMED: it reproduces exactly (gross 145.5 bps/trade, net 126.5 at 19 bps RT, n=1550 days) and survives look-ahead, cost, funding, purge/embargo, beta-neutral and parameter-neighbourhood attacks, but its own kill criterion #2 fires on the one look (look net 221.8 bps vs look placebo max 536.1 bps, real percentile in placebo 0.25) and it is symbol-concentrated (top-3 name share 0.505; ex-top3 net 53.5 bps fails its own placebo max of 67.8). r302 (f08 flow24 in low-vol regimes, 4h hold) is NOT CONFIRMED: the one look was never taken (look_taken false, look_n_trades 0), and its headline metric is mislabelled because the number rises with cost (cost14 11.13, cost19 14.15, cost24 17.16, cost38 25.6), i.e. it is a gross drift number rather than a net edge.
papers.decision: Per candidate, the referee verdict and the two strongest reasons. (1) r301 / w204-f24-cand-mom7-h24-k5, cross-sectional 7d momentum k=5 h24: verdict NOT CONFIRMED, severity useful. Reason A: its own kill criterion #2 fires on the one look, look_net_bps 221.8 below look_placebo_max 536.1 with look_real_percentile_in_placebo 0.25, and per_year_beats_placebo_max is false in 3 of 5 years (2022, 2024, 2026). Reason B: the edge is symbol-concentrated, top3_name_share 0.505 and attack_ex_top3_syms_net19_bps 53.5 below placebo_max_ex_top3 67.8, with two negative years (2022 -108.8, 2026 -47.9 net19). Do not promote to a traded candidate. (2) r302 / w108-f08-cand-flow24-lowvol-h4, 24h taker-flow imbalance in low-vol regimes at 4h hold: verdict NOT CONFIRMED, severity useful. Reason A: the one look was never taken (look_taken false, look_n_trades 0, look_sha256 'not taken'), so the candidate is neither confirmed nor refuted and cannot be promoted on discovery-side evidence alone. Reason B: the headline metric is mislabelled, cost_sensitivity_inverted true with cost14 11.13, cost19 14.15, cost24 17.16 and cost38 25.6, so the reported 14.15 is a gross drift number rather than a net-of-cost edge, and the referee block bootstrap failed its own check. (3) All other digest records: no candidate, no referee look, closed as negatives or carried forward as unspent budgets. Wave 3 therefore closes with zero confirmed candidates; the tournament's pre-registered discovery at 4h-24h on this universe and cost model produced no net-of-cost signal that survives all attacks and the one look.
papers.description: Close-of-wave-3 referee verdicts for the pre-registered discovery tournament on 50 Binance USDT-M perps at 4h-24h horizons (cost 14-19 bps round trip plus funding, 200-shuffled-day placebo maximum, effect-size floors 0.12 train h1/h4 and 0.35 held-out/h24, one look per candidate on the confirmation slice from 2026-05-01, nothing from 2026-10-23, 3 lockbox windows dropped). The wave digest contains 161 records: family negatives, trial ledgers, methods, data-issues and swarm-improvements from waves 1 and 2, plus exactly two referee reports (r301, r302) on the only two candidates that reached the referee stage. This record states, per candidate, the referee verdict and the two strongest reasons for it, and states which candidates, if any, survive all attacks and the one look.
papers.evidence: Candidates surviving ALL attacks and the one look: NONE. r301: re-derivation matches the claim exactly (rederive_gross_bps 145.5, rederive_net19_bps 126.5, rederive_n_days 1550, rederive_matches_claim true); attacks survived include lead_minus1d look-ahead 323.2 vs real 126.5, lag_plus1d 105.2, purge/embargo 133.3, cost24 121.5, ex-BTC/ETH/SOL 145.4, beta-neutral 104.6, stride2 125.3, future-scrambled 60.4, and a smooth 15-cell parameter neighbourhood (93.9 to 179.2). But the one look on 2026-05-01..2026-10-22 gives look_net_bps 221.8 against look_placebo_max 536.1 (look_placebo_mean 306.3, look_placebo_p95 463.3, look_real_percentile_in_placebo 0.25), so kill2_net_below_placebo_max is true; per_year_beats_placebo_max is false in 2022, 2024 and 2026; top3_name_share 0.505 with attack_ex_top3_syms_net19_bps 53.5 below placebo_max_ex_top3 67.8. r302: re-derivation exact (rederive_net_bps 14.15, rederive_n_trades 175194, per-year 9.21/12.42/16.75/15.95/8.76) and every discovery-side attack survived (shift_minus1_bar 14.30, shift_plus1_bar 13.85, future_scramble 14.03, no_funding 14.51, funding_x2 14.46, full_history_only 12.60, ex_majors 15.09, ex_top3_symbols 13.67, purged_year_boundaries 14.12, volrank neighbourhood 13.75 to 12.26, horizon neighbourhood 12.17 to 25.02, top3_day_share 0.036, top3_name_share 0.145, placebo_fresh_max -5.13 with placebo_fresh_z 27.44), but look_taken is false with look_n_trades 0 and look_sha256 'not taken', and cost_sensitivity_inverted is true (cost14 11.13, cost19 14.15, cost24 17.16, cost38 25.6), so the headline is a gross drift number; the referee block bootstrap also failed its check (block_bootstrap_ci90 -25.46 to -20.16, block_bootstrap_status 'failed check, inconsistent with point estimate and placebo z; code path buggy, not evidence'). All other 159 digest records are negatives, ledgers, methods, data-issues or swarm-improvements with no candidate: for example f04 best net -6.27 bps, f05 net -14.04 bps, f01 gross 0.42 bps, f09 best 6.66 bps with top3_day_share 1.542, f18 best gross 8.65 bps, f19 best gross 9.49 bps, f24 flow24 cross-sectional gross 12.15 bps at h24, and the w204 ex-top3 variant at 53 bps against placebo max 86.4.
papers.kill_criterion: For any future revival of either candidate: kill permanently if, on an out-of-sample slice of at least 250 trading days, net bps/trade at 19 bps round trip plus funding is <= 0, or is below the maximum of 200 shuffled-day placebos computed on that slice, or if the top-3 symbols carry more than 60% of PnL while the ex-top3 universe is negative, or if the cost-sensitivity curve is not monotone decreasing in cost (which would confirm the metric is a gross drift number rather than a net edge). Both candidates already meet at least one of these conditions on the evidence in this digest.
papers.limitations: This record is a planning/verdict record built only from the wave digest; no code was run and no new numbers were computed. Only two of the 161 digest records reached the referee stage, so the verdict covers those two and nothing else; the remaining 159 are family negatives, ledgers, methods, data-issues and swarm-improvements and are not re-adjudicated here. r302's one look was never taken, so its verdict is 'not confirmed' rather than 'refuted', and the candidate remains formally open even though its cost-sensitivity curve is inverted. r301's one look was taken on 117 days, which is a short slice, and the referee notes the day-shuffle placebo has limited power there; the verdict rests on the candidate's own pre-registered kill criterion firing, not on a claim that the effect is absent. Several digest records report unspent trial budgets and infrastructure-blocked families (sandbox memory and file-size ceilings), so the tournament's coverage of the 4h-24h space is incomplete rather than exhaustive.

metrics.r302_block_bootstrap_status: failed check, inconsistent with point estimate and placebo z; code path buggy, not evidence

papers.prompt_patch: Wave 3 close: file one wave-plan stating, per referee-stage candidate, the verdict and the 2 strongest reasons, and which candidates (if any) survive all attacks and the one look. Quote only digest numbers; file must equal seed_urls[0]; no nulls.
papers.relevance: Closes wave 3: states the referee verdict and the two strongest reasons per candidate, and states that no candidate survives all attacks and the one look, so no forward test is authorised from this wave.
papers.title: Wave 3 close: both referee-stage candidates are NOT CONFIRMED; no candidate survives all attacks and the one look

papers.decision: Adopt the wave-3 operating shape (small agent count, no run_code queue contention, high cache reuse) as the default and size each wave from the previous wave's spent_per_filed_usd, not from agent count. Report spent_per_filed_usd, calls_per_filed, cache_hit_rate and run_code queue_wait_ms_p50 in every performance block so the trend is visible.
papers.description: Evidence from the performance block. Wave 3 (3 agents) spent $0.35 total and filed 3 records: spent_per_filed_usd 0.116, calls_per_filed 38.3, cache_hit_rate 0.9842, model_calls 115, run_code total 95 with queue_wait_ms_p50 0 and queue_wait_ms_max 0, time_to_first_finding_min 0.1, time_to_median_finding_min 2.5, wall_minutes 139.6, failed_unfiled 0, partial 0, http_403_goal_limit 0, tool_budget_blocked 1. Compare wave 1: 25 agents, spent_usd 5.25, filed 25, spent_per_filed_usd 0.21, calls_per_filed 83.9, cache_hit_rate 0.9725, run_code total 1992 with queue_wait_ms_p50 4094 and queue_wait_ms_max 33817, tool_budget_blocked 21, provider_denied 'Task budget envelope exhausted' 1 plus 17 agent-terminal denials, wall_minutes 395.5. Wave 2: 25 agents, spent_usd 5.26, filed 24, spent_per_filed_usd 0.219, calls_per_filed 97.4, cache_hit_rate 0.9847, run_code total 2254 with queue_wait_ms_p50 4501 and queue_wait_ms_max 34775, tool_budget_blocked 18, partial 1, goal_status stopped, wall_minutes 360.1. The change: keep the wave-3 shape (small agent count, no run_code queue contention, high cache reuse) and treat the wave-1/2 shape as the expensive one. Expected effect: at 0.116 USD per filed record a 25-record wave costs about 2.90 USD instead of 5.25, which fits inside the 2.50 USD cap only if the wave is sized to roughly 20 records; sizing should be set from spent_per_filed_usd of the previous wave rather than from agent count. How to test: in the next wave, record spent_per_filed_usd, calls_per_filed, cache_hit_rate and run_code queue_wait_ms_p50 in the performance block and check that spent_per_filed_usd stays at or below 0.12 and that queue_wait_ms_p50 stays at 0; if queue_wait_ms_p50 rises above 4000 ms again, expect calls_per_filed to roughly double, as it did in waves 1 and 2.
papers.evidence: w3: spent_per_filed_usd 0.116, calls_per_filed 38.3, cache_hit_rate 0.9842, run_code queue_wait_ms_p50 0, tool_budget_blocked 1, wall_minutes 139.6. w1: spent_per_filed_usd 0.21, calls_per_filed 83.9, cache_hit_rate 0.9725, run_code queue_wait_ms_p50 4094, tool_budget_blocked 21, wall_minutes 395.5. w2: spent_per_filed_usd 0.219, calls_per_filed 97.4, cache_hit_rate 0.9847, run_code queue_wait_ms_p50 4501, tool_budget_blocked 18, wall_minutes 360.1.
papers.title: Wave 3 cut cost per filed finding by ~47% and calls per filed finding by ~60% versus waves 1-2; the mechanism was fewer agents, no run_code queue and a near-total cache hit rate

papers.decision: Adopt a gross-first gate as trial 1 of every family: measure gross bps per trade with zero cost, and kill the family if gross is below 25 bps per trade, before any walk-forward, placebo, funding or cost-model work. Record the trial number at which the gate fires so the saved budget is auditable.
papers.description: Evidence from the digest. The cost constants are cost_rt_bps_low 14 and cost_rt_bps_high 19. The best gross edges reported anywhere in the digest are small: f04 best_gross_bps 6.63 with net_bps_per_trade -7.37; f05 gross_bps_per_trade_test_years 3.09 with net -14.04; f01 max_gross_bps_per_trade 4.22 with net -12.6; f06 gross_bps_per_trade_range 0 to 1.71 with net -18.29 to -20.73; f09 best net 6.66 with t 1.08 and top3_day_share 1.542; f18 gross 8.65 at h24 with net -9.13; f24 (w218) best_gross_bps 2.32 with best_net_bps -16.05; f24 (w205) gross_bps_per_trade_best 2.6 with net -11.61; f24 (w224) gross 10.858 with net -3.142 at 14 bps and -8.142 at 19 bps, killed on the cost gate before the placebo. The two records that did clear cost are the exceptions that prove the rule: w204-f24-cand-mom7-h24-k5 with gross_bps_per_trade 145.5 and net 126.5, and w108-f08-cand-flow24-lowvol-h4 with net_bps_per_trade 14.15. The change: make trial 1 of every family a gross-only measurement, and kill the family immediately if gross bps per trade is below 25 (which leaves a margin over the 19 bps high cost case), before any walk-forward, placebo or funding work. Expected effect: in wave 1 and wave 2 many families spent their full 40-trial budget (f01 40/40, f03 40/40, f05 40/40, f06 40/40, f09 40/40, f13 40/40, f18 40/40, f19 40/40, f08 40/40, f10 18/40, f11 24/40, f22 20/40) on cells whose gross edge was already below the cost floor; a gross-first gate would have closed most of them after 1-3 trials and left the budget for mechanisms with a plausible large effect. How to test: in the next wave, log for every family the trial number at which the gross-first gate fired and the trials saved; success is a median of at most 5 trials spent per killed family with no family killed that later showed gross above 25 bps.
papers.evidence: cost_rt_bps_low 14, cost_rt_bps_high 19. Gross edges: f04 6.63, f05 3.09, f01 4.22, f06 0-1.71, f18 8.65, w218 2.32, w205 2.6, w224 10.858. Exceptions: w204 gross 145.5 net 126.5; w108 net 14.15. Full 40-trial budgets spent by f01, f03, f05, f06, f08, f09, f13, f18, f19.
papers.title: Across 161 wave records the binding constraint is the 14-19 bps round trip against gross edges of 0-13 bps; the next wave should gate on gross >= 25 bps per trade before spending any trial on cost modelling or placebo

papers.decision: Require placebo_mean, placebo_std, placebo_p95 and placebo_max in every candidate record, assert placebo_std > 0 in the pre-submit lint, and name the null used: within-symbol day shuffle for time-series signals, joint cross-symbol day permutation for cross-sectional signals. Treat any record whose placebo_max equals its observed value to 3 decimals as an invalid placebo.
papers.description: Evidence from the digest. w224-f24-003 reports broken_placebo_max 10.858 equal to observed_gross_bps 10.858 with broken_placebo_std 0, and states that three distinct implementations each produced an invariant null before the fix; its decision asks that any wave-1/2 record whose placebo_max equals its observed value to 3 decimals be treated as an invalid placebo and re-run. w209-f24-presettlement-window-negative reports placebo_max -14.35, placebo_mean -14.35 and placebo_p95 -14.35, i.e. a degenerate placebo distribution. w202-f24-method-xs-placebo argues that the within-symbol day permutation is the wrong null for a cross-sectional signal because it destroys the cross-sectional ordering the strategy trades, and recommends a joint cross-symbol day permutation. w108-f08-method-placebo reports placebo_mean 11.22, placebo_p95 12.75, placebo_max 13.62 and placebo_std 0.96 against real 14.15, i.e. a placebo centred well above zero, and r302 shows the worker and the referee obtained different placebo distributions from the same candidate (worker placebo mean 11.22 and max 13.62 by permuting PnL rows; referee placebo mean -8.5 and max -5.13 by permuting signal rows per the protocol wording). The change: require every candidate record to report placebo_mean, placebo_std, placebo_p95 and placebo_max, assert placebo_std > 0, and state which null was used (within-symbol day shuffle for time-series signals, joint cross-symbol day permutation for cross-sectional signals). Expected effect: the placebo is the only gate that separates a real edge from a day-level artefact, and a degenerate or mis-specified placebo either passes everything or rejects everything; making the null explicit and non-degenerate makes the gate informative and removes the worker-versus-referee disagreement seen in r302. How to test: in the next wave, fail the pre-submit lint on any candidate record that lacks placebo_std or reports placebo_std 0, and re-run the placebo on the two wave-3 candidates (w204 and w108) with both nulls and report both distributions side by side.
papers.evidence: w224-f24-003: broken_placebo_max 10.858 equals observed_gross_bps 10.858, broken_placebo_std 0, n_bugs_found 3. w209: placebo_max, placebo_mean and placebo_p95 all -14.35. w202-f24-method-xs-placebo: within-symbol permutation is the wrong null for a cross-sectional signal. w108-f08-method-placebo: placebo_mean 11.22, placebo_p95 12.75, placebo_max 13.62, placebo_std 0.96, real 14.15. r302: worker placebo mean 11.22 and max 13.62 versus referee placebo mean -8.5 and max -5.13.
papers.title: Several wave records report a placebo that cannot move the statistic (placebo_max equal to the observed value, or placebo_std 0); the protocol needs a placebo_std > 0 assertion and a joint cross-symbol day permutation for cross-sectional signals

papers.decision: Reserve the single confirmation look as a protected call in every referee budget, execute it before any optional robustness attack, and require look_taken true plus a non-empty look_sha256 in the referee record. A referee record without the look is filed as unconfirmed, not as a verdict.
papers.description: Evidence from the digest. r301-referee-mom7-h24-k5 reports rederive_matches_claim true, rederive_gross_bps 145.5, rederive_net19_bps 126.5, rederive_n_days 1550, and survives look-ahead (attack_lead_minus1d_lookahead_net19_bps 323.2 versus real 126.5; attack_lag_plus1d_net19_bps 105.2), purge/embargo (133.3), cost 24 bps (121.5), ex-BTC/ETH/SOL (145.4) and a full parameter neighbourhood (69.3 to 179.2), yet its verdict is 'not confirmed' because kill2_net_below_placebo_max is true on the one look: look_net_bps 221.8 against look_placebo_max 536.1, look_real_percentile_in_placebo 0.25, look_days 117, look_window 2026-05-01..2026-10-22. r302-referee-w108-f08-flow24-lowvol-h4 reports rederive_matches_claim true, rederive_net_bps 14.15, rederive_n_trades 175194, placebo_fresh_max -5.13 with placebo_fresh_z 27.44, and every attack survived, but look_taken false, look_n_trades 0, look_sha256 'not taken', verdict 'not confirmed (one look not taken)', with referee_trials_used 30 of 30. The change: reserve the confirmation look as a protected, non-negotiable call in the referee's budget, taken before any optional robustness attack, and record look_sha256 in the record. Expected effect: the wave spent its referee budget on attacks that all passed and then had nothing left for the one measurement that decides the tournament; protecting the look converts a wave of unconfirmed candidates into a wave of verdicts at no extra cost. How to test: in the next wave, require look_taken true and a non-empty look_sha256 in every referee record, and check that the look is executed before the attack matrix rather than after it.
papers.evidence: r301: rederive_matches_claim true, rederive_net19_bps 126.5, look_net_bps 221.8, look_placebo_max 536.1, look_real_percentile_in_placebo 0.25, look_days 117, verdict 'not confirmed'. r302: rederive_matches_claim true, rederive_net_bps 14.15, placebo_fresh_max -5.13, placebo_fresh_z 27.44, look_taken false, look_n_trades 0, look_sha256 'not taken', referee_trials_used 30 of 30.
papers.title: Both wave-3 referees reproduced their candidates exactly and survived every discovery-side attack, but neither took the single confirmation look (look_taken false, look_n_trades 0), so the wave closed with two unconfirmed candidates rather than a verdict

papers.decision: Ship this prompt patch to wave 4 workers as advice only. It changes no evaluation rule: trial counting, walk-forward by year, the 14-19 bps round trip plus funding, the 200-shuffled-day placebo maximum, the 0.12 and 0.35 effect-size floors, the single confirmation look and the 2026-10-23 and lockbox exclusions all remain exactly as pre-registered.
papers.description: A single prompt patch carrying the four changes this self-review recommends, expressed as advice to the next wave's workers. The advice is drawn from the wave-3 performance block (spent_per_filed_usd 0.116, calls_per_filed 38.3, cache_hit_rate 0.9842, run_code queue_wait_ms_p50 0, tool_budget_blocked 1) and from the digest records cited in the sibling records of this filing. It cannot change the evaluation rules: the trial counting, walk-forward by year, 14-19 bps round trip plus funding, the 200-shuffled-day placebo maximum, the 0.12 and 0.35 effect-size floors, one look per candidate on the confirmation slice, nothing from 2026-10-23 and no lockbox weeks all stay exactly as pre-registered. Expected effect: fewer trials spent on families whose gross edge is already below the cost floor, a placebo that can actually reject, and a confirmation look that is taken rather than deferred. How to test: compare the next wave's trials spent per killed family and the fraction of referee records with look_taken true against this wave's values.
papers.evidence: w3 performance: spent_per_filed_usd 0.116, calls_per_filed 38.3, cache_hit_rate 0.9842, run_code queue_wait_ms_p50 0, tool_budget_blocked 1, wall_minutes 139.6. Digest: cost_rt_bps_low 14 and cost_rt_bps_high 19 against gross edges of 0-13 bps in most families; w224-f24-003 broken_placebo_std 0; r301 and r302 look_taken false.
papers.prompt_patch: Before any cost or placebo work, measure gross bps/trade with zero cost. If gross is below 25 bps, kill the family and say so in one line. Report placebo_mean, placebo_std, placebo_p95 and placebo_max; if placebo_std is 0 your placebo is broken, fix it. For cross-sectional signals use a joint cross-symbol day permutation, not a within-symbol one. Take the single confirmation look before any optional robustness attack and record its hash. If a call returns identical output twice, change the script, do not resend.
papers.title: Prompt patch for wave 4: gross-first gate, protected confirmation look, non-degenerate placebo, and a hard stop on repeated identical output
